title: Electric courier skiff
description: An original teal electric skiff with cream deck, canopy, two engine pods, antenna and glowing headlight. Approximately 2.7 wide by 4.1 long; forward is +Z. Feet at y=0. A compact player vehicle for flooded worlds.
author: the internet slop warehouse

title: Magnetic salvage tug
description: An original amber hover tug with light bar eyes, ring thrusters and a front magnetic fork. Forward is +Z; roughly 2.8 wide and 3.6 long. Texture-free materials. A player or friendly industrial NPC.
author: the internet slop warehouse

title: Resonator crystal
description: An original octahedral crystal suspended above a brass pedestal, circled by a thin ring. About 2.2 units tall. Named Crystal mesh can be recolored for matching puzzles; no external textures.
author: the internet slop warehouse

title: Marsh signal buoy
description: An original teal-and-brass buoy with a luminous beacon and ring guard. About 2.4 units tall, base centered at the origin. Ideal for checkpoints, navigation markers and delivery destinations.
author: the internet slop warehouse

title: Porcelain garden caretaker
description: An original small porcelain-and-brass caretaker robot with a single spherical wheel, teal collar, visor and two emissive eyes. About 1.85 units tall, forward +Z. Texture-free; suitable for small exploration and puzzle worlds.
author: the internet slop warehouse
